blocks.title: Common ion effect
blocks.text: Kamzor electrolyte mein mushtarka (common) ion shamil kar ke us ki ionization ko dabana common ion effect kehlata hai.

Sodium chloride ko brine, NaCl ke saturated solution, mein hydrogen chloride gas guzar kar saaf (purify) kiya jata hai. Solution mein sodium chloride poori tarah ionised hai, NaCl(s) se Na+(aq) + Cl-(aq), Kc = [Na+][Cl-] / [NaCl] ke saath. HCl bhi solution mein ionise hoti hai, HCl(g) se H+(aq) + Cl-(aq). HCl gas guzarne par Cl- ki concentration barhti hai, to equilibrium constant ki mustaqil qeemat barqarar rakhne ke liye NaCl solution se crystal ban kar nikal aata hai: Na+(aq) + Cl-(aq) se NaCl(s). Kam halne wale electrolyte ke solution mein common ion shamil karna us ki ionization dabata hai, aur ghair-ionised species ki concentration barhti hai, jo precipitate ke taur par nikal sakti hai.

items: Kam halne wale salt KClO3 ki pani mein solubility zyada halne wala salt KCl shamil kar ke dabai jati hai; K+ common ion hai, KClO3 ki ionization dabti hai aur woh precipitate ke taur par beth jata hai.

Kamzor acid H2S ka dissociation, H2S se 2H+ + S2-, zyada taqatwar acid HCl shamil kar ke dabaya jata hai; H+ common ion hai, tezabi solution mein H2S kam dissociate hota hai, aur paida hone wali S2- ki kam concentration salt analysis mein doosre group ke basic radicals ko precipitate karne mein madad karti hai.

NH3 solution mein NH4Cl, ek strong electrolyte, shamil karna NH4Cl se NH4+ ki bari miqdar ki wajah se OH- ki concentration dabata hai; yeh milap salt analysis mein teesre group ke basic radicals ka group reagent hai.

blocks.text: Common ion effect ke qualitative analysis aur buffers ki tayyari mein wasee istemalat hain.

blocks.prompt: AgCl ke saturated solution mein kuch NaCl solution dala jata hai. [Ag+] ko kya hota hai, aur kyun (Quick Check 9.4b)?
blocks.explanation: Shamil kiya gaya Cl- common ion hai. Equilibrium AgCl(s) se Ag+ + Cl- hasil-e-zarb [Ag+][Cl-] mustaqil rakhne ke liye baen shift hota hai, to silver chloride precipitate hota aur [Ag+] girta hai: common ion se AgCl ki solubility dab jati hai.

items: Common ion kamzor ya kam halne wale electrolyte ki ionization dabata hai: brine mein HCl NaCl precipitate karti hai; KCl KClO3 ko; HCl H2S ko ghair-ionised rakhti hai (group II ke liye kam S2-); NH4Cl ammonia mein OH- ghatata hai (group III reagent).
Qualitative analysis aur buffers banane mein istemal.
